results.title: 40 Nostalgic-Looking Photos Shared By Photographers On Threads
results.description: There's a certain kind of photo that stops you mid-scroll. The colors are a little warmer than real life, the light looks like late afternoon even when it isn't, and everything carries a soft haze, as if the moment happened decades ago. You know these images were taken recently, yet they feel like memories, the kind you'd find tucked inside an old photo album or catch in a single frame of a film from another era.
